name: Aasimar
age: Aasimar mature at the same rate as humans but can live a few decades longer. (You can choose Small or Medium size.)
alignment: Under the 2024 rules a creature's species doesn't determine its alignment; choose freely.
languages: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language of your choice. (Ability score increases come from your background, not your species, under the 2024 rules.)

traits.name: Celestial Resistance
traits.desc: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage and Radiant damage.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.desc: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Healing Hands
traits.desc: As a Magic action, you touch a creature and roll a number of d4s equal to your Proficiency Bonus. The creature regains a number of Hit Points equal to the total rolled. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Light Bearer
traits.desc: You know the Light cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Celestial Revelation
traits.desc:
Starting at character level 3, as a Bonus Action you can transform for 1 minute, taking on a celestial form. Choose one of the following each time you transform; once during the transformation you can deal extra damage to one target equal to your Proficiency Bonus when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The transformation ends early if you are Incapacitated or die.

- **Heavenly Wings** — You gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.
- **Inner Radiance** — You shed Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet; at the end of each of your turns, each creature within 10 feet of you takes Radiant damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- **Necrotic Shroud** — Each creature of your choice within 10 feet that can see you must succeed on a Charisma saving throw (DC 8 + your Charisma modifier + your Proficiency Bonus) or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.
